claims.claim: Plan state stores status/content/hash/read/context/model fields.
claims.finding: Also includes reminder count and approval/cutoff timestamps; full schema is SAFE-003.

claims.finding: Latest matching branch record only; invalid newest does not fall back to an older record; exact customType equality.

claims.claim: tool_call blocks tools outside the effective mode set.
claims.finding: Both visibility and dispatch are covered, with origin/access-class rules.

claims.claim: Plan mode permits read tools, ask/draft/propose and read_plan.
claims.finding: read_plan is unavailable until a plan exists; allowlist includes goal/subagent names and declared nonexternal read tools. A legacy allowlist name is not proof of registered capability.

claims.claim: Build edit/write require trusted project, and Bash requires the flag.
claims.finding: Built-in edit/write are present even untrusted; trust gates declared extension writes, external tools and Bash. Bash additionally requires build and current-process --ice-allow-bash.

claims.claim: Build mutations require read_plan after approval.
claims.finding: Exact gate covers edit/write/integrate_writer_patch and agent_patch apply, not arbitrary extension writes or Bash. Resume preserves readInBuild; build re-entry and compaction reset it.

claims.claim: validateMutationPath rejects outside root unless allow-external.
claims.finding: Requires effective trusted-build external access, not flag alone. That opt-in bypasses protected .git/.env/credential names too, after prospective-path resolution.

claims.claim: Every successful mutation bumps generation and patch receipts integrate.
claims.finding: Only matching authorized native IDs count; failed/unknown results and unobserved shell/external writes do not. Patch applied/verified, unverified and rollback_conflict have distinct branches.

claims.claim: Hidden plan and approved context is injected before agent start.
claims.finding: Exact custom types, prompts and display=false are specified.

claims.claim: A reminder is injected whenever a plan turn lacks ask/propose.
claims.finding: Any tool call suppresses this prose-only path; pending/aborted/already-scheduled states suppress it; cap 3; headless print/json early return differs from RPC.

claims.claim: Fresh policy trims at approval cutoff.
claims.finding: Latest execution-start marker takes precedence over timestamp fallback; unmatched retained tool results are removed; durable session history remains.

claims.claim: Mode-specific model flags swap model and restore preplan thinking.
claims.finding: Exact scope/ambiguity/fallback and UI-selection rules added; unavailable auth/lookup only warns.

claims.claim: Verifier runs no-shell argv with 120000 ms timeout and 64 KiB output cap.
